notes.title: Experimental version is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there Station Managers!

I am now happy to announce that[/h3]
[h2]We are releasing the new experimental version of
Space Station Manager![/h2]

The time has come!

Space Station Manager Remake, from now branded as [b]Space Station Manager 2048[/b] is available, and you can try it out right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/9ac14a7c8ddec58c7f9792632e93889faeab555f.png[/img]

[b][i]Due to the experimental nature of the release, any feature is a subject to changes, and not all features are fully functional just yet.[/i][/b]
To access the experimental version, enter the secret branch activation code: [u]ssm2password[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/b908bb51cef0de5852598177336270e322117703.png[/img]

[b]How do I use the "secret branch activation code"?[/b]
[u]Right-click the game in your library, and select Properties > Betas. There you can enter the code, and click "Check Code".[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/fcf6ec7555c880de0a112ade8bd3a8a9fc6dc56e.gif[/img]

However, there are few more things to say about this.

Firstly, I want you to keep in mind that this is a very early version of the game, and that it might lack some features, which will be added in the next updates.

Even the implemented features may not work flawlessly at the moment, as they are still being built.
if you do find something that looks non-intentional, is difficult to get around, or any idea in general, do not hesitate to start a discussion thread right here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1250100/discussions/1/]Experimental Version Forum[/url]

It is also worth a note, that most of the development resources went into research, and building a reliable architecture for the game, and not into features themselves. As the base of the game is close to being finished, the speed of development will only increase from this point onward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/f6eccba30d3cc3a9b21266c10b6a971cdba4d4e6.png[/img]

At the moment, the main goal is to make a copy of the old version, but in a new, more flexible way.
Those plans however don't end there. After all of the features from the old version are implemented, we will start implementing features that were planned, but never implemented. And even after that, there are completely new features and game mechanics that are planned, and are coming your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/e6a733f2f4035ec397ca8e22a06756d67de95548.png[/img]

If you have any further questions, comment them below this post, or on our new forum for the experimental version: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1250100/discussions/1/]Experimental Version Forum[/url]

[i]I would also like to give thanks to everybody who contributed to the making of the project, as well as the community that has gathered around this game. Without you all, this game would not be what it is now, and it would not be possible to make it what it can be in the future.[/i]

[h3]We wish you Happy Holidays, and a Happy New Year![/h3]

notes.title: Experimental Version Release Date
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there station managers!

After a year of continuous work, I am happy to announce that[/h3]
[h2]We will be releasing a new experimental version of
Space Station Manager this Christmas [/h2]

This experimental version of the [b]Space Station Manager rewrite[/b] will be available on an "experimental" branch on Steam, released on 24. December 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/282c37fe3dd6f6a919de2fa744c59e907a30ed49.png[/img]

Just as in the old version, you will be tasked with setting up and running your very own Space Station.
In this Experimental version, updates will be made to fix bugs and improve the game as we move to full release with a new branding and more things to explore than ever before. Take on the challenge of deep space and grow your empire. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/2de9eaeca8dd3290bde9e588966ed91771ced4b2.png[/img]

[b][i]Due to the experimental nature of the release, any feature is a subject to changes.[/i][/b]

[h3]I am hoping to push out into an alpha release in the first half of 2022, and with some luck, it may be by the beginning of said year.[/h3]

Even after release of an alpha version, full version, and the experimental version, there will be more updates coming, including a few major features, and several content updates. Those features will include mechanics from the old game, as well as some new mechanics, such as map exploration, and maybe even multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/dd8b6770256493bc9ef28530037acd555132d954.png[/img]

I would also like to give thanks to everybody who contributed to the making of the project, as well as the community that has gathered around this game. Without you all, this game would not be what it is now, and it would not be possible to make it what it can be in the future.

[h3]Thank you all, and happy holidays wherever you may be.[/h3]

notes.title: Game Remake still in progress
notes.content:
[h1]Game Rewrite is still in progress[/h1]
However, we want to share some news with the community!

The new version of the game is under development for a long time now, and it still will be for some time.
Despite that, we can still share some news, changes, and major decisions regarding the game.

[h2]New features[/h2]

With the new version, there will be new features and game mechanics, which will expand the gameplay with new possibilities.
New major features are:
[list]
[*]Procedurally generated world
[*]Exploration
[*]Multiplayer
[/list]
[i]Note that not all features will be implemented with the first release[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/2fd69c2880a3cb8ddafe057b976b7667a3df8746.png[/img]

[h2]Old features[/h2]

There has been made changes to all of the old features as well. Most of them are minor, but there are some big changes, such like:

[list]
[*]3D Map
[*]New graphics
[*]Upgraded research
[/list]
And there will be more to come!

[h2]Release date?[/h2]
Unfortunately, the development is a very bumpy ride, and it is very hard to predict when the game will be released, therefore, the only expectation is somewhere within 2021.
I will post more updates, which will hopefully bring more exact release date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/f12787d64a2ee34961ffe792d5e1b63307f58abe.png[/img]

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
And we would also like to say big thanks to the community!
This project has changed someone's life, and made it better, however, this project would be nothing without you!
I am giving my personal thanks, and I will do my best to not disappoint you with the new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36923305/5b7d48277c7abc3d8ae1e92234803ca810ddfbaf.png[/img]

[h2]Questions & Answers[/h2]

[h3]Do I have to pay for the new version?[/h3]
The new version is completely free for current game owners, and will replace the old version.

[h3]Will the new version be fundamentally different from the old version?[/h3]
There are some major changes in how the game is controlled, however apart from some changes, the game is fundamentally the same.

[h3]Can I still play the old version?[/h3]
The old version will still be available in an alternative branch 'obsolete', you can switch to in the game properties on Steam right now, however development of the old version is discontinued.

[h3]Can I load old save in the new version?[/h3]
Unfortunately no, there is no support for opening old saves for now. This may change in the future.

[h3]Will the game price change when the remake is released?[/h3]
No, the price will remain the same.

[h3]When will be the new version released?[/h3]
Currently there is no set release date, but it should be within the year 2021

[h3]Will the new version be released as a final version?[/h3]
The new version will be released to catch up with the old version, and updates will continue from there until the game comes out of Early Access. After Early Access there may still be content updates or bug fixes.

[h2]Content related questions[/h2]

[h3]How big will the map be?[/h3]
The new world will contain at least 3 galaxies, with the central one holding over 120,000 star systems. In total, the map will contain roughly 230 thousand stars.
The world can also be generated with a seed.

[h3]How will the exploration work?[/h3]
The exploration mechanics will mainly consist of 2 parts: 
Locating an object, and mapping the object.
There are few approaches, and more steps you can take to find yourself something valuable.
You will either be able to explore an object from afar, or send a recon vehicle directly to the place.
Each approach will have it's advantages and disadvantages.

[h3]How will players interact in a multiplayer session?[/h3]
The interaction of players will come in many forms. Players will be able to see each other, trade, combat and steal from each other, or even co-operate. This is completely up to the players, as companies can be created grouping players together.

[h3]In what way is the research different?[/h3]
The new research mechanics will now begin with research from items, and things such as observatory is now in the early-mid game. It will also take some time to unlock the tech nodes themselves.

[h3]Combat?[/h3]
Yes, there will be combat and warfare in the game. This feature was already planned for the old version, however it was not implemented yet. It will be implemented in the new version.
You will be able to weaponize your ships, or even your stations, manage a fleet, plan an attack, or use some advanced defensive technologies, such as shields, or point defense.
Do you not like loud combat? That's fine! You can take alternative stealthy approach to combat!
You will be able to snipe enemies from distance, go undercover, or even make your station completely undetectable.

[i]Any other questions may be answered in the discussion below[/i]

notes.title: Full Game Remake in progress!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Managers[/h1]

We are anouncing, that the game is under complete re-writing, and will be released to the public whenever it's content becomes comparable or bigger to that of the current game version.
This remake will feature brand new graphics, better optimization, less bugs, and better platform for us developers, allowing for faster and bigger content updates.
As of now there is no specific date of release other than 2021, however this will change with one of future announcements.

[h3]Minor Update[/h3]
As a tiny bonus, we are releasing German localization for the current game.
The translation is done by [b]Max Frierdrich (WhiteAki)[/b]

[h2]Questions you may have[/h2]

[h3]Do I have to pay for the new version?[/h3]
The new version is completely free for current game owners, and will replace the old version.

[h3]Will the new version be fundamentally different from the old version?[/h3]
There will be a major difference in how the game is controlled, however apart from minor changes, the game will work exactly the same.

[h3]Can I still play the old version?[/h3]
The old version will still be available in an alternative branch 'obsolete', you can switch to in the game properties on Steam right now, however development of the old version is discontinued.

[h3]Can I load old save in the new version?[/h3]
Unfortunately no, there is no support for opening old saves for now. This may change in the future.

[h3]Will the game price change when the remake is released?[/h3]
No, the price will remain the same.

[h3]When will be the new version released?[/h3]
Currently there is no set release date, but it should be within the year 2021

[h3]Will the new version be released as a final version?[/h3]
The new version will be released to catch up with the old version, and updates will continue from there until the game comes out of Early Access. After Early Access there may still be content updates or bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.5.11
notes.content:
[h1]In the update 1.5.11, we bring you support for more languages!
We have also added ship task conditions, for advanced cargo management, and made a few small changes.[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added support for localization
[*]Ships can now have various engine types
[*]Added custom conditions for ship assignments and automatic shopping
[*]Added alternation for part rotation to break repeated pattterns
[/list]

[h2]New Blocks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Small Radial Airlock
[*]Added Medium Windowed Ending
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Saves now sort by last opened
[*]Transport job can now have multiple items
[*]Increased frequency at which items are bought from the market
[*]Increased efficiency of stacking observatories
[*]Item count is now shown withreserved amount discounted
[*]Ships no longer transport items if less than their cargo capacity is available
[*]Reduced ranger (Ship) top speed
[*]Selecting existing tag now directly adds the tag
[*]New nuclear reactor effect
[*]Camera speed is now shown when scrolling in free look
[*]Removed 10 cargo space limit for ship harvesting
[*]Increased bit depth for station icon color from 2 bits to 5 (From 64 colors to 32 768 colors)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed quick action getting overlapped by tag settings
[*]Fixed stations created in one session sharing open/closed state
[*]Fixed inverse scroll wheel when free look is enabled
[/list]

notes.title: The Dawn of industry Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Dawn of industry Update[/h1]

Today we present you the dawn of industry update, that allows you to harvest resources, refine them, craft more valuable materials from them, and sell them.

You can also create your very own ships, that you can send to mine resources, or transport items in between your stations.

We have also added many more utilities to make your life easier, like Freeplay mode, Master station screen, and much more.

[h2]Main features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added user owned ships
[*] Added resource harvesting
[*] Added item transportation
[*] Added automated shopping
[*] Added freeplay mode (unlimited money)
[*] Added medium sizes of Experimentation Bay and Hydrogen Cell
[*] Added master station screen
[/list]
[h2]Minor features and changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added station icons and station icon color
[*] Added dark smooth theme
[*] Reworked most of sounds, effects, and models of customer ships
[*] Fueled generators can now be disabled, and are now defaultly disabled
[*] Added few objects to the map
[*] Production blocks now show item input and what items are missing if any
[*] Reduced science yield drop for Experimantation Bay to 25%
[*] Blocks effects now correspond to their state (working/idle)
[*] Stations now show spending on items
[*] Renamed the 'Leave' button to 'Save and Leave'
[*] Reduced power of solar panel MK 2 to be 250% of MK 1
[*] Reduced cost of solar panel MK 2 to be 600% of MK 1
[*] Reduced time cost of many crafting recipes
[/list]
[h2]Bigger bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed station blinking when using fueled generators
[/list]
+9 minor bug fixes

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
[h1]Today and now, we release Space Station Manager into Early Access.[/h1]
[h3]After few months of hard work, testing, and dealing with pandemic, I am happy to finally release the game to the public.[/h3]
I hope you are also doing well. It is hard time now, and we need to stay strong. I hope someone will find interest in this, or any other game I release in the future, and it will make their life happier.
